gate_reasons.complete_16: All16 slots must be collected without hard-stop/error/unattempted slots
gate_reasons.physical_arrival_and_stop: Every arm must have8/8 physical arrivals and observed stable2s stops; retain known failures
gate_reasons.measurement_and_provenance: Invalid/missing integrity is not evidence of performance benefit or harm
gate_reasons.required_metrics_present: No missing/nonfinite metric is zero-filled or dropped from the decision population
gate_reasons.approach_comparable: No failed caliper exclusion; preserve both blocks and all pairs
gate_reasons.executed_intervention_before_next_contac: Every reactive run needs measured command/target reduction before a subsequent loaded contact and body/joint evidence; precontact intervention invalidates isolation
gate_reasons.worthwhile_primary_benefit: Both block point benefits and aggregate lower95% bound must meet the prespecified minimum; overlap gives inconclusive
gate_reasons.secondary_and_whole_route_no_worsening: Point-estimate nonworsening per block; a failed point gate is not a claim of statistically proven harm
gate_reasons.complete_contact_sequence_same_direction: Do not dilute a longer contact sequence into a favorable fixed-window-only conclusion
gate_reasons.existing_time_tracking_caps: Each block:mean time<=18.5s and1.05xPI;mean physical RMSE<=1.05xPI
gate_reasons.application_added_time: Upper95% added-time bound must fit application seconds; interval crossing limit is inconclusive
gate_reasons.primary_sampling_direction_stable: Any primary-slip sign reversal across originalGT/20ms/+10ms makes evidence inconclusive; never select favorable origin

approach.qualification: A failed/missing caliper invalidates a clean postcontact comparison; do not exclude or replace the episode.

bootstrap.unit: intact pair resampled within fixed seed

recommended_action: Stop this frozen intervention/small-screen branch; no automatic extra episodes or parameter search
